gloss: joining a group, team, or troupe

definitions.gloss: joining a group, team, or troupe
definitions.explanation: The act of formally becoming a member of an organized group such as a sports team, theater troupe, or youth organization. The group joined is marked with に.

examples.japanese: プロ{野球|やきゅう}チームに{入団|にゅうだん}した。
examples.english: He joined a professional baseball team.

examples.japanese: {息子|むすこ}がサッカーの{少年団|しょうねんだん}に{入団|にゅうだん}した。
examples.english: My son joined a youth soccer club.

examples.japanese: {入団|にゅうだん}テストに{合格|ごうかく}して{念願|ねんがん}のチームに{入|はい}ることができた。
examples.english: I passed the tryout and was able to join the team I had always dreamed of.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・チームに{入団|にゅうだん}する (join a team)
・{入団|にゅうだん}テスト (tryout, entry test)
・{入団|にゅうだん}{会見|かいけん} (joining announcement press conference)
・{入団|にゅうだん}{希望|きぼう} (desire to join a team)

USAGE NOTES:
Used specifically for organized groups ({団|だん}), especially sports teams and performing arts troupes. For joining a club ({部|ぶ}), use {入部|にゅうぶ}. For joining a company, use {入社|にゅうしゃ}. For joining an association or society, use {入会|にゅうかい}.
